summary.en: Give objects a valid starting state with overloaded constructors and this delegation.
summary.bn: ওভারলোড করা কনস্ট্রাক্টর আর this দিয়ে অবজেক্টের শুরুর অবস্থা ঠিক করো।

notes: Constructor delegation must be first under Java 17 rules; later Java releases have different constructor-body features.

sections.title: Start an object with meaningful values
Declare one starting path or several
Follow initialization in the right order
Recognise declarations that are not constructors
Make initialization part of the interface

examples.title: Two ways to create a ticket
examples.explanationHtml: The no-argument constructor delegates to the one-argument version with 1. The group ticket starts with 4 seats.

examples.title: Resolve a shadowed name
examples.explanationHtml: The parameter and field share a name. this.mark identifies the field receiving the parameter value.

examples.title: Trace initialization order
examples.explanationHtml: The field initializer prints field, then the instance block prints block, and finally the constructor prints body.

examples.title: A declared no-argument constructor
examples.explanationHtml: This no-argument constructor is written explicitly. It is not a compiler-provided default constructor.

practice.title: Ticket seats
practice.statementHtml: Input: seats from 0 to 50. Create Ticket with its parameterised constructor and print seats.

practice.title: A default opening balance
practice.statementHtml: Input: opening balance from 0 to 10000. Create one Wallet with no arguments and one with that balance. Print their balances separated by one space.
hints: Let the no-argument constructor call this(0).

practice.title: Construct a rectangle
practice.statementHtml: Input: width and height from 0 to 1000. Initialise both fields in a constructor and print the area.
hints: Do not give the constructor a void return type.

practice.title: Normalise a starting mark
practice.statementHtml: Input: any integer from -100 to 200. A Result constructor clamps it to 0 through 100. Print the saved mark.
hints: Choose an explicit out-of-range policy for construction.

quiz.prompt: Which constructor value follows this(1) delegation?
quiz.explanation: The no-argument constructor delegates with 1, which is stored in seats.

quiz.prompt: Which name receives the assignment when this.mark is explicit?
quiz.explanation: The initializer first sets 10; the constructor body replaces the field value with 65.

quiz.prompt: In what order do field initialization and the constructor print?
quiz.explanation: Instance field initialization occurs before the constructor body.

quiz.prompt: When does Java supply a default constructor?
options: When the class declares no constructor
quiz.explanation: Declaring any constructor suppresses the automatically supplied one.

quiz.prompt: Which declaration is a constructor for Student?
quiz.explanation: A constructor has the class name and no return type or static modifier.

quiz.prompt: Where must this(...) appear in a Java 17 constructor?
quiz.explanation: Java 17 requires an explicit constructor invocation to be the first statement.

quiz.prompt: What does this refer to in an instance constructor?
quiz.explanation: this identifies the current instance, including its fields.

options: To support different argument lists for initialisation
quiz.explanation: Each overload can express a useful way to supply starting state.

quiz.prompt: Can two constructors delegate to each other forever with this(...)?
options: No; recursive constructor invocation is rejected
quiz.explanation: The compiler rejects circular constructor delegation.

quiz.prompt: Which initialization runs once per object in a this(...) chain?
quiz.explanation: Delegation reaches a constructor that performs initialization; fields are not initialized again at each return.

quiz.prompt: Does this(1) allocate a second object inside a constructor?
options: Yes; every constructor call uses new
Only if the constructor is private
No; it initializes the same object through another constructor
Only when the argument is int
quiz.explanation: Constructor delegation shares the current object and reuses an initialization path.

quiz.prompt: Why centralize shared validation in the constructor reached by delegation?
options: To keep one consistent initialization rule
quiz.explanation: Delegating overloads can share one complete policy rather than duplicating checks.

keyPoints.en: A constructor has the class name and no return type.
keyPoints.bn: কনস্ট্রাক্টরের নাম ক্লাসের মতো, কিন্তু রিটার্ন টাইপ থাকে না।

keyPoints.en: A compiler-provided default constructor exists only when no constructor is declared.
keyPoints.bn: নিজে কোনো কনস্ট্রাক্টর না লিখলেই কম্পাইলার ডিফল্ট কনস্ট্রাক্টর দেয়।

keyPoints.en: this.field names the current object field.
keyPoints.bn: this.field দিয়ে বর্তমান অবজেক্টের ফিল্ড বোঝায়।

keyPoints.en: this(...) delegates to another constructor in the same class.
keyPoints.bn: this(...) একই ক্লাসের আরেক কনস্ট্রাক্টরকে ডাকে।

keyPoints.en: In Java 17 a constructor delegation call must come first.
keyPoints.bn: জাভা ১৭-তে কনস্ট্রাক্টর ডেলিগেশনের কল প্রথমে থাকতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Field initializers run before the constructor body after superclass construction.
keyPoints.bn: সুপারক্লাস তৈরির পর ফিল্ডের শুরুর মান বসে, তারপর কনস্ট্রাক্টরের বডি চলে।

examQuestions.question: Differentiate a default constructor from an explicit no-argument constructor.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A default constructor is supplied by the compiler when none is declared. An explicit no-argument constructor is written by the programmer and may contain custom initialization.

examQuestions.question: Trace a field initializer setting 5 followed by a constructor assigning 9.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The new object first has default field values. After superclass construction the initializer assigns 5. The constructor body then assigns 9, so the final field value is 9.

examQuestions.question: Design two constructors for a Wallet so the no-argument version opens with zero.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Write Wallet() delegating to this(0). Write Wallet(int balance) assigning this.balance after applying the chosen validation policy. Keep the delegation first in Java 17.
